attribution.text: Crystallography Open Database (COD), with the original authors of the structural data

provenance.notes: COD home page (read 2026-11-10, after a first connection reset; its PSDI mirror cod.psdi.ac.uk states the same): all data and the database itself are dedicated to the public domain under CC0; users "should acknowledge the original authors of the structural data" (a request under CC0, see the "Citing COD" wiki page). The RESTful API wiki page states no rate limit. The code's 0.5 s throttle rests on an observed 403 after eight calls in ten seconds, not on a published rule. The bug-report address is published only as an image.
